# opnsense_firewall_group (Resource)

Configures an OPNsense firewall interface group.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `members` (Set of String) Logical interface identifiers that belong to the group.
- `name` (String) Group name. Maximum 15 characters; letters, digits, and underscores only; must not start or end with a digit.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `no_gui_group` (Boolean) Do not group these members in the Interfaces menu.
- `sequence` (Number) Priority used when sorting groups.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the group.
